evidence.reason: At the pinned tip, `prepare()` reads `repair.cq_bin` with `measure_cq_bin()` and then proceeds toward admission and the hold without requiring that an absolute non-placeholder runtime entry exists. The later runtime pointer check can reject the same missing entry only after the switch, and rollback would hit the same check, so the runbook can take the admission hold and switch with no usable runtime entry. This is an ordinary correctness defect; the smallest fix is to require existence at preflight while keeping the later checks for post-preflight deletion.
